# Dataset Card for DexJoCo

This dataset provides the raw data for DexJoCo: A Benchmark and Toolkit for Task-Oriented Dexterous Manipulation on MuJoCo.

See more at:
- Hugging Face Paper: [https://huggingface.co/papers/2605.16257](https://huggingface.co/papers/2605.16257)
- arXiv Paper: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16257](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16257)
- GitHub: [https://github.com/brave-eai/dexjoco](https://github.com/brave-eai/dexjoco)
